confidence_notes: Overall medium. Food and drink anchors come from search-result excerpts of Can Tho cost-of-living sites (Numbeo, Citycost, Livingcost, Hikersbay, Wise, Expatden), not direct page reads. The Numbeo Can Tho figure is dated July 2024, so 2026-labelled sources carry more weight. Beer, coffee and meals are corroborated across sources. Cocktail rests on a few tourist-bar listings found by search. wine_glass has no direct Can Tho figure; it is set at roughly four to five times the local draft beer and cross-checked against mid-range bottle prices of about 7.6 to 7.8 USD. Accommodation anchors are low-confidence model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 RBA entry as surfaced by search, not a direct page read; a 19 Nov entry may exist.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city was used for food and drink; anchors follow Can Tho-specific cost-of-living sources. An older Numbeo comparison put Can Tho budget meals and cappuccinos at roughly half of Ho Chi Minh City prices, with draft beer and mid-range dinners similar. Accommodation is a general-knowledge placement for a second-tier Mekong Delta city, priced below Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang, with no listings checked.
